items.title: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says
items.brief: 成本压力下弃用Claude，转投OpenAI合作，模型供应格局生变。
items.summary: Masad said the decision was made for a number of different reasons, including cost. Replit announced a partnership with OpenAI in August, but there was never any indication that it was no longer with Anthropic.
items.author: Lucas Ropek

items.title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
items.brief: 凭证泄露与过宽云权限成入口，AI代理已开始被真实滥用。
items.summary: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
items.author: Aditya Mehta

items.title: 90% of US working hours are spent on tasks not covered well by AI benchmarks
items.brief: 现有评测只覆盖少数任务，与实际工作场景严重脱节。
items.summary: Article URL: https://www.mercor.com/research/labor-index/benchmark-map/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50121179 Points: 391 # Comments: 325
items.author: speckx

items.title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
items.brief: 执行器、机械手、安全标准仍在重建，机器人尚处拼装阶段。
items.summary: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.
items.author: Theresa Loconsolo, Dominic-Madori Davis

items.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
items.brief: Glimpse在图表推理与短视频描述上超过GPT-6 Astra。
items.summary: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.
items.author: Aditya Mehta

items.title: Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries
items.brief: 让模型预先整理长文档工作区，主动预判后续查询而非被动检索。
items.summary: Reasoning over long document contexts remains a challenge for large language models (LLMs). Standard retrieval methods are inherently reactive, bottlenecking agents with complex, cross-document reasoning at inference time, while precomputed structures like knowledge graphs often fall short because…
items.author: Anikait Singh, Teresa Zhang, Yoonho Lee

items.title: Learning to Steer LLM Agents and Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents and multi-agent systems increasingly tackle complex tasks through long-horizon tool use and inter-agent collaboration.
items.author: Leyang Shen, Yaxin Gong, Yang Zhang

items.title: Private Retrieval Augmented Generation via Random Projection
items.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by querying external structured knowledge. However, it can also introduce privacy risks by leaking sensitive information from the retrieval datastore.
items.author: Dixi Yao, Tahseen Rabbani, Tian Li

items.title: Language Is a Security Surface for Agent Guards
items.summary: Step-level guards decide, before each tool call, whether an agent's next action is safe given the user's request and the trajectory so far. Users write those requests in many languages, while guard prompts and the benchmarks on which purpose-built guards are trained and evaluated are English.
items.author: Hasan Demirkiran, Jens Ernstberger
